newsitem.title: USA: Atrix gets FDA filing acceptance. [CORRECTED 17:11 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Atrix gets FDA filing acceptance. [CORRECTED 17:11 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects the headline to show that NDA was not filed today, but that the FDA accepted the NDA for filing.)
Atrix Laboratories Inc said on Monday that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has accepted for filing its new drug application for ATRIDOX subgingival antibiotic therapy for periodontal disease.
Pending regulatory approvals, the company said ATRIDOX will be marketed in North America and Europe by Block Drug Co Inc.
Atrix also said it is establishing a distibution network for marketing dental products outside of the territories licensed to Block.
Atrix develops and markets dental, medical and veterinary products.
